message.source: Hold modifier keys and drag the mouse

message.translation: 開啟初始設定嚮導介面。

message.source: Control which modules are preloaded at startup. Disable to speed up launch. Changes take effect after restart.
message.translation: 控制啟動時預載入哪些模組。關閉可加快啟動速度。修改後重新啟動生效。

message.source: Pre-scan system font list on startup
message.translation: 啟動時預掃描系統字型列表

message.source: Pre-load the capture engine, canvas and tools
message.translation: 預載入截圖引擎、畫布、工具等模組

message.source: Pre-create toolbar widgets to avoid first-capture lag
message.translation: 預建立工具列控制項，避免首次截圖卡頓

message.source: Pre-load OCR model in background thread
message.translation: 在背景執行緒中預載入 OCR 模型

message.source: Pre-create the settings dialog on startup
message.translation: 啟動時提前建立設定視窗
啟動時初始化剪貼簿監聽

message.source: Control the behavior of the selection info panel during screenshot.
message.translation: 控制截圖時選區資訊面板的行為。

message.source: Hide the info panel while dragging the selection area
message.translation: 拖曳選區時隱藏資訊面板

message.source: Restore the default settings of this page?
message.translation: 確定恢復此頁面的預設設定？

message.source: Some in-app shortcuts conflict within the same group. Please fix them first.
message.translation: 同組記憶體在重複的快速鍵，請先修正衝突。

message.source: The new shortcut was not saved.
This is the same as a global hotkey — the system intercepts it first, so it won't work here.
message.translation: 和某個全域快速鍵相同，會被系統先攔截，這個快速鍵實際不會生效。

message.source: "%1" is already used by "%2". Replace it?
message.translation: "%1" 已被 "%2" 使用。 是否替換？

message.source: 💡 Hint: Click the input box and press the desired key combination.
message.translation: 💡 提示: 點擊輸入框後按下想要的快速鍵組合。

message.source: 💡 Hint: You can use modifier keys like Ctrl, Shift, Alt.
message.translation: 💡 提示: 可以使用 Ctrl, Shift, Alt 等修飾鍵組合。

message.source: Skip this many top pixels on subsequent captures during matching
message.translation: 匹配時跳過後續截圖頂部的畫素行數

message.source: Double-click the selected screenshot to copy it to the clipboard and close the capture.
message.translation: 雙擊已選截圖時複製到剪貼簿並關閉截圖。
啟用 Ctrl 跨工具選擇

message.source: Hold Ctrl and click any editable annotation to adjust it without switching tools.
message.translation: 按住 Ctrl 點擊任意可編輯標註，無需切換工具即可調整。

message.source: Keep text above other annotations, including ones drawn later.
message.translation: 讓文字保持在其他標註上方，包括之後繪製的標註。

message.source: Start new text annotations at about 30 characters wide and keep them inside the selection.
message.translation: 新增文字標註預設約 30 個字元寬，並限制在選區內。

message.source: Snap the selection to the window or control under the cursor. Control detection reads the accessibility tree and takes longer on large windows.
message.translation: 讓選區自動貼合游標下的視窗或控制項。檢測元素需要讀取無障礙樹，視窗越大耗時越久。

message.source: Slide the selection when it moves from one window or control to another.
message.translation: 選區在視窗或控制項之間移動時滑動過渡。

message.source: 1. Move cursor over window during capture
message.translation: 1. 截圖時將游標移到視窗上

message.source: 2. Area will be highlighted with blue border automatically
message.translation: 2. 區域會自動以藍色邊框標示
寫入檔案路徑到剪貼簿

message.source: Lets tools that only recognize a file path (e.g. some terminal apps) paste the screenshot too. Only takes effect when the screenshot is auto-saved.
message.translation: 讓只認檔案路徑的工具（如部分終端程式）也能貼上截圖。只在自動儲存時生效。

message.source: Screenshots are saved to the save folder automatically when the actions below finish.
message.translation: 下面的操作完成時，自動把截圖存進儲存資料夾。

message.source: Saves when a screenshot is finished, including confirming a screenshot, long screenshots, global mouse shortcut screenshots, and more.
message.translation: 完成截圖時自動儲存，包括確定截圖、長截圖、全域滑鼠截圖等。

message.source: When a Pinned Image Is Created
Saves when a selected region becomes a pinned image, including regular pins, global mouse shortcut pins, long screenshot pins, and more.
message.translation: 選擇區域生成釘圖時自動儲存，包括普通釘圖、全域滑鼠釘圖、長截圖釘圖等。

message.source: When a screenshot with annotations (including mosaic) or a watermark is saved to the save folder, a copy without them is saved too, with _original at the end of its file name.
message.translation: 截圖存進儲存資料夾時，如果加了標註（含馬賽克）或浮水印，再另存一張沒有它們的原圖，檔名末尾帶 _original。

message.source: Compression quality (1-100). Only affects JPG and WebP.
message.translation: 壓縮品質 (1-100)，僅影響 JPG 和 WebP。

message.source: 💡 Hint: Even with auto-save off, it will be copied to clipboard.
message.translation: 💡 提示: 即使關閉自動儲存，也會複製到剪貼簿。

message.source: No OCR Version / OCR module not found
message.translation: 無OCR版本 / 未找到OCR模組

message.source: This is a casual version without OCR.
message.translation: 這是一個不帶OCR的簡易版本。

message.source: If you need OCR features, please download the full version,
message.translation: 如需OCR功能，請下載完整版，

message.source: On very low-end computers, OCR after pinning may cause a brief stutter. Turn off automatic recognition if needed.
message.translation: 超低配電腦上，釘圖後的 OCR 可能導致瞬時卡頓，可以關閉自動文字辨識。
在這裡切換 OCR 引擎。

message.source: Where the text recognition result window appears.
message.translation: 文字辨識結果視窗出現的位置。

message.source: The Snipping Tool engine is faster and reads more languages, but needs the Snipping Tool from Windows 11. PP-OCR works on any Windows.
message.translation: 截圖工具引擎更快、支援的語言更多，但需要 Windows 11 的截圖工具。PP-OCR 在任何 Windows 上都能用。

message.source: OCR unavailable: install the Snipping Tool from the Microsoft Store, or download the full version
message.translation: OCR 不可用：請從 Microsoft Store 安裝截圖工具，或下載完整版

message.source: Auto language detection: Supports Chinese, Japanese, English mixed recognition
message.translation: 自動語言檢測: 支援中日英混合辨識

message.source: 💡 Supports 100+ languages: Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, etc.
message.translation: 💡 支援100+種語言：中文、英語、日語、韓語、阿拉伯語等

message.source: Saves app activity logs to file.
message.translation: 將應用活動日誌儲存到檔案。

message.source: Auto-delete old logs after the selected period
message.translation: 按所選期限自動刪除舊日誌

message.source: Current Log: (Not generated) *Log will be created after app starts
message.translation: 目前日誌: (未生成) *日誌將在應用啟動後建立

message.source: No log files yet. Please start and use the app first.
message.translation: 還沒有日誌檔案。請先啟動並使用應用。

message.source: *Changes will fully take effect after restart.
message.translation: *更改將在重新啟動後完全生效。

message.source: Register in Windows startup via registry.
message.translation: 透過登錄檔註冊 Windows 開機啟動。

message.source: Lets screenshots capture administrator windows such as Task Manager. Launching it by hand also runs as administrator, without a UAC prompt.
message.translation: 可以擷取工作管理員等管理員視窗。手動啟動時也以管理員身份執行，不彈 UAC 確認。

message.source: Changing it asks for administrator permission. Turning it on restarts the program as administrator.
message.translation: 更改時會請求管理員權限，開啟後程式會以管理員身份重新啟動。

message.source: Run as administrator was not turned on.
message.translation: 未能開啟以管理員身份執行。

message.source: Run as administrator could not be turned off. It still starts as administrator at sign-in.
message.translation: 未能關閉以管理員身份執行，登入時仍會以管理員身份啟動。
釘圖時自動顯示繪圖工具

message.source: On: Shows toolbar when mouse enters pinned window.
message.translation: 開: 滑鼠進入釘圖視窗時顯示工具列。

message.source: Off: Show via right-click toolbar button.
message.translation: 關: 透過右鍵選單工具列按鈕顯示。

message.source: Select display language. Restart required after change.
message.translation: 選擇顯示語言。更改後需要重新啟動。

message.source: 💡 Hint: Even with background startup, you can operate from system tray.
message.translation: 💡 提示: 即使背景啟動，也可以透過系統匣操作。

message.source: Copy this file to back up your settings or use them on another computer.
message.translation: 複製這個檔案即可備份設定，或帶到別的電腦上使用。

message.source: Load settings from another settings.ini or a file exported by an earlier version. Folder locations stay unchanged.
message.translation: 從另一份 settings.ini 或舊版本匯出的檔案載入設定；各類資料夾位置保持不變。

message.source: This file is not a Jietuba settings file, or it is damaged.
message.translation: 這個檔案不是 Jietuba 的設定檔案，或者已經損壞。

message.source: Click the button on the right to test the translation API
message.translation: 點擊右側按鈕測試翻譯介面

message.source: Enable if you have a paid DeepL subscription
message.translation: 付費訂閱使用者請啟用

message.source: Paired with APPID in the Baidu console
message.translation: 主控台「開發者資訊」裡與 APPID 成對的金鑰
百度翻譯開放平臺 · 開發者資訊

message.source: LLM translation: better with context and idioms, but slower, billed per token, and may refuse some content
message.translation: 大模型翻譯：更懂上下文和習慣用法，但更慢、按 token 計費，且可能拒絕部分內容

message.source: Merge multi-line text for better translation
message.translation: 合併多行文字以獲得更好的翻譯

message.source: Which formats Shift cycles through on the magnifier, for C to copy.
message.translation: 放大鏡上按 Shift 在哪些格式之間切換，按 C 複製目前顯示的那個。

message.source: Ask for JSON replies. If the service rejects it, the request is retried without; turn it off to skip that retry
message.translation: 要求模型以 JSON 回覆。服務不支援時會去掉後自動重試一次；關閉可省掉這次重試

message.source: Any OpenAI-compatible service. Ollama: http://localhost:11434/v1, LM Studio: http://localhost:1234/v1
message.translation: 任意 OpenAI 相容服務。Ollama：http://localhost:11434/v1，LM Studio：http://localhost:1234/v1
服務沒有返回任何模型

message.source: Show horizontal and vertical guide lines across the screen while capturing.
message.translation: 截圖時顯示隨滑鼠移動、貫穿全螢幕的水平和垂直輔助線。

message.source: Draw the mouse pointer into the screenshot where it was when capturing started.
message.translation: 開始截圖時，把滑鼠指標按當時的位置畫進截圖。

message.source: Windows 11 rounds the corners of pinned images and adds a shadow. Turn off to show the whole image with square corners and no shadow.
message.translation: Windows 11 會給釘圖加圓角和陰影。關閉後釘圖以直角顯示，四個角不再被裁掉，也沒有陰影。

message.source: New pinned images get a theme-colored border. Each image can still toggle it from the right-click menu.
message.translation: 新釘圖四周顯示一圈主題色描邊，單張釘圖仍可在右鍵選單裡開關。

message.source: Show the close and toolbar buttons in the top-right corner when the mouse is over a pinned image. When off, use the right-click menu or shortcuts.
message.translation: 滑鼠移到釘圖上時，在右上角顯示關閉和工具列按鈕。關閉後可用右鍵選單或快速鍵操作。

message.source: Opacity of newly pinned images. Each image can still be adjusted with the mouse.
message.translation: 新釘圖的不透明度。每張釘圖仍可用滑鼠單獨調整。

message.source: Opacity of a pinned image when click-through starts from its right-click menu. The slider on the bar above it still adjusts each image.
message.translation: 從右鍵選單開啟滑鼠穿透時釘圖的不透明度。穿透時釘圖上方工具條的滑塊仍可單獨調整。

message.source: Copy, lock, thumbnail, toolbar and other keys for pinned images.
message.translation: 釘圖的複製、鎖定、縮圖、工具列等按鍵。

message.source: Zoom, opacity, close and other mouse actions for pinned images.
message.translation: 釘圖的縮放、透明度、關閉等滑鼠操作。

message.source: How much one wheel notch zooms, relative to the original size.
message.translation: 滾輪每格縮放的幅度，按原圖大小計算。

message.source: Zoom step for the fine zoom mouse shortcut (Alt + wheel by default).
message.translation: 精細縮放滑鼠快速鍵（預設 Alt + 滾輪）每格的縮放幅度。

message.source: Opacity change per notch of the opacity mouse shortcut (Ctrl + wheel by default).
message.translation: 調整不透明度的滑鼠快速鍵（預設 Ctrl + 滾輪）每格的變化量。

message.source: The point of the image that stays in place while zooming with the wheel.
message.translation: 用滾輪縮放時保持不動的位置。

message.source: Drag near the edge or corner of a pinned image to resize it. The aspect ratio is kept.
message.translation: 在釘圖的邊緣或角上拖曳即可調整大小，寬高比保持不變。

message.source: Images larger than the screen are scaled down to fit and centered when pinned.
message.translation: 比螢幕還大的圖釘出來時按比例縮小到螢幕內，並放在螢幕中間。

message.source: Locked images cannot be dragged, zoomed or resized.
message.translation: 鎖定的釘圖不能拖曳、縮放或調整大小。

message.source: The close button and the close mouse shortcut do nothing on locked images.
message.translation: 鎖定的釘圖上，關閉按鈕和關閉用的滑鼠快速鍵不起作用。

message.source: Esc does nothing on locked images.
message.translation: 鎖定的釘圖上按 Esc 不會關閉。

message.source: Show a short hint when locking, unlocking or trying a blocked action. The right-click menu always works on locked images.
message.translation: 鎖定、解鎖或嘗試被禁止的操作時顯示簡短提示。鎖定的釘圖始終可以用右鍵選單。

message.source: Choose which paste options appear and arrange their order.
message.translation: 選擇顯示的貼上選項，並調整它們的順序。

message.source: Ending the screen annotation keeps its drawings; they come back the next time it starts.
message.translation: 退出螢幕標註時保留畫出的內容，下次開始時恢復。

message.source: What screen annotation starts with. In pass-through the mouse keeps working the windows below until a tool is picked.
message.translation: 開始螢幕標註時處於什麼狀態。穿透時滑鼠照常操作下方的視窗，選了工具才開始畫。

message.source: Not set. Screen annotation also starts from the tray menu.
message.translation: 未設定。也可以從系統匣選單開始螢幕標註。

message.source: Where the toolbar appears when screen annotation starts.
message.translation: 開始螢幕標註時工具列出現在哪裡。

message.source: Keeps the toolbar and its panels out of recordings, screenshots, screen sharing, remote desktop and other screen capture; you still see them. Turn off to let them be captured, for example when recording a tutorial.
message.translation: 讓工具列及其面板不會被螢幕錄影、截圖、螢幕分享、遠端畫面等擷取，你自己照常看得見。錄教學等需要錄進工具列時可關掉。

message.source: Choose and order the buttons of the screen annotation toolbar. Saved at once.
message.translation: 選擇螢幕標註工具列顯示哪些按鈕及順序，調整後立即儲存。
開始時開啟游標醒目提示

message.source: Starts with a light around the pointer. The toolbar button turns it on and off during a session, and that choice is kept.
message.translation: 開始時指標周圍就有光暈。標註過程中可用工具列按鈕開關，開關的結果會被記住。

message.source: The size of the light around the pointer and of the click rings.
message.translation: 指標周圍光暈和點擊漣漪的大小。

message.source: A ring spreads from every click: yellow for the left button, blue for the right.
message.translation: 每次點擊擴散出一圈漣漪：左鍵黃色，右鍵藍色。

message.source: Please select a valid capture area first.
message.translation: 請先選擇一個有效的截圖區域！

message.source: Failed to capture the selected area.
Please configure DeepL API key in Settings.
message.translation: 請先在設定中配置 DeepL API 金鑰

message.source: Please configure DeepL API key in Settings.
message.translation: 請先在設定中配置 DeepL API 金鑰

message.source: Ctrl+click any editable annotation to edit it temporarily
message.translation: 按住 Ctrl 點擊任意可編輯標註，可臨時編輯
馬賽克（滑鼠滾輪調整大小）

message.source: Pen tool (hold Shift for straight line)

message.translation: 繪製矩形（按住Shift畫正方形）

message.source: Pass through: the mouse works the windows below (Esc)
message.translation: 穿透：滑鼠操作下方的視窗 (ESC)

message.source: Whiteboard: click to cover the screen with white, click again to remove
message.translation: 白板：點一下鋪上白色背景，再點一下取消

message.source: Cursor highlight: a light around the pointer and a ring for every click
message.translation: 游標醒目提示：指標周圍發光，每次點選出現漣漪

message.source: OCR recognition could not be started
Scroll slowly from top to bottom
Auto scroll (move the mouse to stop)
message.translation: 自動捲動（移動滑鼠即停止）

message.source: Crop top: remove everything above the current view
message.translation: 裁切頂部：去掉目前畫面以上的內容

message.source: Crop bottom: remove everything below the current view
message.translation: 裁切底部：去掉目前畫面以下的內容

message.source: Crop left: remove everything left of the current view
message.translation: 裁切左側：去掉目前畫面左邊的內容

message.source: Crop right: remove everything right of the current view
message.translation: 裁切右側：去掉目前畫面右邊的內容

message.source: Choose folder to save pinned images
message.translation: 選擇儲存釘圖的資料夾
已儲存 {saved} 個釘圖，失敗 {failed} 個。

message.source: The following hotkeys failed to register:
The hotkey may be occupied by other programs. Please try a different combination.
message.translation: 該熱鍵可能已被其他程式佔用。請嘗試其他組合。

message.source: Finish capturing or saving before updating. The download has been kept.
message.translation: 請結束截圖或背景儲存後重試，下載結果已保留。

message.source: Finish recording or scrolling and close that window before updating. The download has been kept.
message.translation: 請結束錄製或捲動截圖並關閉相應視窗後重試，下載結果已保留。

message.source: Finish exporting before updating. The download has been kept.
message.translation: 請結束匯出後重試，下載結果已保留。

message.source: Wait for application initialization to finish before updating.
message.translation: 請等待軟體初始化完成後重試。

message.source: Update cancelled because the settings window was not closed.
message.translation: 設定視窗未關閉，已取消更新。

message.source: Settings could not be saved. Update cancelled.
message.translation: 設定儲存失敗，已取消更新。
翻譯結果將顯示在這裡...

message.source: No voice installed for this language. Add one in Windows Settings > Time & language > Speech.
message.translation: 沒有安裝這種語言的語音，可在 Windows 設定 > 時間和語言 > 語音 中新增。
未配置 API 金鑰，請前往設定中配置。

message.source: Get your API key from DeepL website (free tier available)
message.translation: 從Deepl網站獲取API金鑰（有免費版）

message.source: Leave empty to follow system language
Automatically split text into sentences for better translation
message.translation: 自動將文字分割成句子以獲得更好的翻譯

message.source: Keep original text formatting in translation
message.translation: 在翻譯中保留原文格式

message.source: DeepL free tier: 500,000 chars/month. Get API key at
message.translation: DeepL 免費版：每月 50 萬字元。獲取 API 金鑰：

message.source: DeepL offers a free API tier with 500,000 characters/month.
message.translation: DeepL提供免費API，每月50萬字元額度。

message.source: Visit https://www.deepl.com/pro-api to get your API key.
message.translation: 訪問 https://www.deepl.com/pro-api 獲取您的API金鑰。

message.source: Stop translation once the monthly free quota is reached
message.translation: 當月度免費額度用盡時停止翻譯

message.source: Volcengine machine translation: about 2M free characters/month. Overuse is billed at pay-as-you-go rates, so a local quota guard (default on) prevents surprise charges.
message.translation: 火山機器翻譯：每月約 200 萬免費字元。超出後依用量計費，本機額度保護（預設開啟）可防止意外扣費。

message.source: Tencent Cloud TMT: about 5M free characters/month. The API rejects overuse itself; the local quota guard (default on) is extra protection.
